understanding: Cover IIR pending bit0 and highest-priority bits 3-1 codes with documented source-reset controls plus fixed bits 7-6 on every wishbone_bus IIR read using passive uart_interrupt observation.
preconditions: Clock running on wb_clk_i and reset on wb_rst_i with symbolic polarity-duration-sequencing pending question; IIR at reset C1h [f_iir_reset]

Bindings: wishbone_bus owns wb_adr_i wb_dat_i wb_we_i wb_stb_i wb_cyc_i wb_sel_i and observes wb_dat_o wb_ack_o; uart_interrupt observes int_o; serial_data owns srx_pad_i and observes stx_pad_o; modem_control_if owns cts_pad_i dsr_pad_i ri_pad_i dcd_pad_i and observes rts_pad_o dtr_pad_o; clock owns wb_clk_i and reset owns wb_rst_i
IIR read is wishbone_bus READ with 3-bit wb_adr_i value 2 and read-only access [f_iir_reg]
Passive observers from t_obs_mon available for wishbone_bus IIR reads and uart_interrupt events
stimulus_steps: wishbone_bus: READ address 2 after reset to capture no-pending baseline [f_iir_nopending1 f_iir_reset]

FOR each documented source IN line-status rx-available timeout THRE-empty modem-status DO: owner creates source via serial_data or modem_control_if or wishbone_bus documented reset-control complement THEN wishbone_bus READs IIR address 2 [f_iir_code011 f_iir_code010 f_iir_code110 f_iir_code001 f_iir_code000]

wishbone_bus: APPLY documented reset controls read LSR, drop FIFO below trigger, read Receiver Buffer, write THR or read IIR, read MSR each on owning interface only [f_iir_reset_line f_iir_rx_trig f_iir_timeout_reset f_iir_thre_reset f_iir_modem_reset]
wishbone_bus: RE-READ IIR address 2 after each reset control to observe pending clear or next highest priority [f_iir_highest f_iir_pending0]
check_steps: COMPARE IIR bit0 pending 0 versus no-pending 1 from wishbone_bus IIR read data against uart_interrupt observation [f_iir_pending0 f_iir_nopending1]

COMPARE IIR bits 3-1 highest-priority code 011 010 110 001 000 against active documented source present before read [f_iir_highest f_iir_code011 f_iir_code010 f_iir_code110 f_iir_code001 f_iir_code000]

COMPARE IIR source-reset pairing: line-status source with LSR read reset, RX-available with FIFO-below-trigger reset, timeout with Receiver-Buffer read reset, THRE-empty with THR-write-or-IIR-read reset, modem with MSR-read reset [f_iir_src_line f_iir_reset_line f_iir_rx_trig f_iir_timeout_src f_iir_thre_reset f_iir_modem_reset f_iir_timeout_reset]
COMPARE IIR bits 7-6 equal 1 on every IIR read [f_iir_fixed76]
coverage_steps: SAMPLE navigation label cg_iir_basic pending bin and code bins from wishbone_bus monitor IIR read data valid at clock edge [f_iir_pending0 f_iir_nopending1 f_iir_code011 f_iir_code010 f_iir_code110 f_iir_code001 f_iir_code000]
SAMPLE fixed compatibility bits 7-6 equals 1 on every sampled IIR read [f_iir_fixed76]
SAMPLE reset-control association observed with each IIR code sample for later cross analysis [f_iir_reset_line f_iir_rx_trig f_iir_timeout_reset f_iir_thre_reset f_iir_modem_reset]
completion: WAIT for wishbone_bus IIR read queue and uart_interrupt event queue to drain within TEST_TIMEOUT_CYCLES operational limit not DUT timing
CLEANUP release wishbone_bus serial_data modem_control_if uart_interrupt handles with monitors driving nothing

facts.statement: IIR is 8-bit read-only register at bus address 2 to get interrupt information
facts.quote: Interrupt Identification 2 8 R Get interrupt information

facts.statement: IIR bit 0 value 0 indicates interrupt pending
facts.quote: Bit 0 indicates that an interrupt is pending when it’s logic ‘0’.

facts.statement: IIR bit 0 value 1 indicates no interrupt pending
facts.quote:
When it’s ‘1’ – no interrupt
is pending.

facts.statement: IIR reports current highest priority pending interrupt
facts.quote:
The IIR enables the programmer to retrieve what is the current highest priority pending
interrupt.

facts.statement: IIR bits 3-1 value 011 is 1st priority Receiver Line Status
IIR bits 3-1 value 010 is 2nd priority Receiver Data available
IIR bits 3-1 value 110 is 2nd priority Timeout Indication
IIR bits 3-1 value 001 is 3rd priority Transmitter Holding Register empty
IIR bits 3-1 value 000 is 4th priority Modem Status
facts.quote: 0 0 0 4 th Modem Status CTS, DSR, RI or DCD. Reading the Modem

facts.statement: Receiver Line Status source is parity overrun framing errors or break
Receiver Line Status is reset by reading Line Status Register
Receiver Data source is FIFO trigger reached and reset when FIFO drops below trigger
facts.quote:
FIFO trigger level reached FIFO drops below
trigger level

facts.statement: Timeout source is at least 1 character in FIFO with no input or read for last 4 char times
facts.quote:
There’s at least 1 character
in the FIFO but no character
has been input to the FIFO
or read from it for the last 4
Char times.

facts.statement: Timeout is reset by reading Receiver Buffer Register
facts.quote:
Reading from the
FIFO (Receiver
Buffer Register)

facts.statement: THR empty is reset by writing Transmitter Holding Register or reading IIR
facts.quote:
Writing to the
Transmitter Holding
Register or reading
IIR.

facts.statement: Modem Status is reset by reading Modem status register
IIR bits 7-6 are fixed to 1 for compatibility
facts.quote: Bits 6 and 7: Logic ‘1’ for compatibility reason.
